# Traveloka

> > Traveloka is Southeast Asia's leading travel and lifestyle platform, offering flight bookings, hotels, activities, and corporate travel management solutions across Indonesia and the region.

Traveloka provides comprehensive travel services for both consumers and businesses. The B2B corporate travel platform helps companies manage business travel, track expenses, enforce travel policies, and integrate with HR systems for streamlined travel management and invoicing.

## Key Topics

- Corporate Travel Management
- Business Travel Solutions
- Expense Tracking
- Travel Policy Enforcement
- HR Integration
- B2B Platform
- Invoice and Payment Management
- Indonesia Travel Services
- Southeast Asia Travel
- Flight and Hotel Bookings
- Travel Technology Platform

## Corporate Travel Solutions

- [Corporate Travel Management Indonesia - Traveloka](https://corporates.ctv.traveloka.com/): Traveloka B2B platform for corporate travel management in Indonesia
